sanity.contract: mode=none must reproduce scripts/eval_multIou.py on the same weights (tianchi18_mosaic1280 best.pt: mean 0.6349, mAP@0.5 0.5917; tianchi18_full best.pt: mAP@0.5 0.541); mode=box and mode=cls mAP must be >= mode=none
sanity.note: only mode=none self-checks against eval_multIou; run mode=none with the same weights and compare to verify the contract and the box/cls monotonicity

matching.protocol: one-to-one greedy assignment, candidate pairs taken in descending IoU order (same rule as ultralytics match_predictions)

mAP_note: not reported in fp mode (spec: fp reports the FP partition only)

background_clean_image.description: FP on an image with no GT (clean image)

duplicate_or_neighbour.description: FP on a defect image explained by an already-matched object (or a residual spurious box, see sub_reasons)

duplicate_same_class_matched_gt.description: IoU >= iou_thr with an already-matched GT of the predicted class

overlaps_matched_pred_box.description: IoU >= iou_thr with an already-matched (TP) prediction box

residual_defect_image.description: residual FP on a defect image: no >= iou_thr GT overlap and no matched-box overlap (kept in (b) so the partition is exhaustive)

wrong_class.description: IoU >= iou_thr with a GT of a different class
